content_of_post_to_comment: Where are the writers that don’t write about how to write on substack? I want to read fiction, deep dives, personal experiences, and different point of views. I didn’t get on substack to read about how to write on substack. I write about my experiences as a special needs mom and I know that’s not for everyone. But it seems like topics being written about is for the writers and not the readers.. Maybe it’s just my algorithm from just now joining.
comment: Maybe there’s a difference between writing for an audience and writing for other writers. Substack seems to reward the latter because writers are also its most visible readers. The quieter readers may be looking elsewhere.
